title: WPSS/24678/1999 of SMT. SAUKARANI Vs STATE AND OTHERS.

paras.text:
W.P. No. 2704 (S/S)01:
Old no. 24678/99
Hon'ble M.M. Ghildiyal, J.
Modification & Final Disposal
Application no. 2131/2004:-
Heard leaned Standing Counsel for
the applicant and Sri P.C. Jhingan,
learned counsel for the petitioner/
opposite party on the application.
Learned Standing Counsel for the
State by means of this modification
application has prayed to modify/vacate
the interim order dated 15.06.1999
passed in the instant writ petition and
dispose of the same in terms of the
judgment and order dated 21.02.2002
passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in
Civil Appeal no. 3634/1998 State of U.P.
& ors. Vs. Putti Lal.
The writ petition has already been
decided by this Court on 30th September
2003 with the direction to the
respondents to consider the case of the
petitioner in the light of the judgment of
Hon'ble Supreme Court in Civil Appeal
no. 3634 of 1998, State of U.P. and ors.
Vs. Putti Lal.
The application is misconceived
and, as such, is rejected.
(M.M. Ghildiyal, J.)
28.09.2005:
